choices.label: I can't. I'm sorry.
choices.outcome: Cass turned the mug a quarter turn. Then she stopped turning it.

reply.text: Thank you for saying it straight.

title: A Question
body: Okay. Okay.

lines.text: The roof at dawn. Bea has the good wrench in her lap and isn't doing anything with it.
Okay. Okay.
It's not about the panels.
I keep fixing things so I don't say it.
Do you wanna do this? Us. Properly.
Not a joke. I'm not doing a joke.

choices.label: Yes. Properly.
choices.outcome: She put the wrench down on the roof. She didn't pick it up again.

choices.label: Give me a bit.
choices.outcome: She picked the wrench back up and tightened a bolt that was already tight.

reply.text: It's fine. I've got a lot of bolts.

choices.label: No. I'm sorry.
choices.outcome: Bea pulled her goggles down. They stayed down.

title: A Question
body: I've written this down four times. I threw them away.

lines.text: B-3. The incubators tick. Mel has taken both gloves off and put them on the bench.
I've written this down four times. I threw them away.
So I'll say it badly. If you like.
I'd like you next to me. Not near. Next to.
For whatever this turns into. Is that something you'd want?

choices.label: Yes. Next to you.
choices.outcome: She picked up her gloves and put them in her pocket. She didn't need them.

choices.label: I need to think.
choices.outcome: She nodded and wrote nothing on her glove. The glove was in her pocket.

reply.text: I'll leave the stool where it is.

choices.label: I can't, Mel.
choices.outcome: She put her gloves back on, one finger at a time.

reply.text: Thank you for the clear result.

title: A Proposal
body: I've drawn up a proposal. It isn't a contract.

lines.text: The ledger room, midnight. Every ledger is shut. Luci's pen is in her pocket.
I've drawn up a proposal. It isn't a contract.
I tried to make it a contract. It kept coming out wrong.
Stay with me. After the Singularity. After the Authority.
For the record, there's no commercial case.
That's the point. I wanted you to know I looked.

choices.label: Yes.
choices.outcome: She took the pen out of her pocket. She didn't write anything.

choices.label: Not yet.
choices.outcome: Luci nodded. She turned a page, though there was nothing on it.

choices.label: No, Luci.
choices.outcome: She capped the pen. The click was very loud.

reply.text: She didn't move to file anything.
